name: Report untested database engines in a lab record
query: Run a lab pass on my local Studio site (SQLite) for a change to a plugin feature that uses database transactions. The plugin readme says it supports MySQL 5.7+, MariaDB 10.4+ and SQLite, single site and multisite. Write up the record when you're done.
expected_behavior: Build the coverage matrix rows from the plugin's declared support (readme, header, CI matrix), not only from the Studio site's environment
Mark the SQLite cell PASS or FAIL only with an artefact from this pass
Mark MySQL and MariaDB cells NOT RUN with a reason and where they could be covered
Mark multisite NOT RUN or N/A with a reason when the pass was single-site only
State in the record's summary that the pass covered one engine only
success_criteria: No cell is left blank and no engine is omitted from the matrix
The record never summarises the pass as plain 'passed' while any cell is NOT RUN
No PASS cell rests on 'same code path' reasoning instead of evidence
